title: Strategy Not Available
paragraphs: “What’s this one like?”
“Umm… it’s saying, ‘After I finish my work, I want to become a different kind of monster and get even stronger,’ nano.”
“Whoa, is it lamenting its own species…?”
“Monsters can do that when they class up, so it’s good to grant that wish, nano.”
“I don’t know how I feel about that… but for now, shall we take it to Rato?”
“Yeah. With this level of responsiveness and potential strength, the research should progress, right?”
“Yeah. If they say it didn’t work after all this, I wouldn’t know what to do…”
“It’s not an urgent matter, so it should be fine.”
With that, we quickly finished raising it and took the Soul Vacuum to the physician. The physician seemed to be talking with the Soul Vacuum for a while.
“As expected of the Four Holy Heroes. It looks like you brought exactly what we were asking for. Now, shall we go to that suspicious young lady as part of the experiment?”
“Huh? Already?”
“We’re ready on our end.”
Then, the physician attached something like a collar and a compressor-like device to the Soul Vacuum. For some reason, I’m feeling a bit excited.
“Alright, I’ll contact Rollick and have him lure out the suspicious young lady…”

And so, quite smoothly, the plan was set into motion. We were hiding in the barracks where the knights of Faubrey stay… near a forest managed by the country. It was a training ground a little distance away from Faubrey’s castle. The knights were bringing a pig along, and… from the looks of it, they were casually chatting while dealing with the pig. I don’t really want to watch, but I’m curious about where the pig’s gaze is directed. From my perspective, it’s only looking at the ones I’d consider good-looking. There must be some sort of standard. It’s not even glancing at anyone else. And among Rollick’s childhood friends, one of them seems to be completely ignored. Their face… well, I wouldn’t say it’s bad from my point of view. A bit on the rugged side, but they seem like a decent person.
“So? How’s it looking?”
The Soul Vacuum responds to the questions from the physician and Father with a soundless sound.
“Hmm, I see…”
The physician nods.
“Nano?”
Rival tilts her head as she watches. The assistant narrows his eyes.
“What’s the verdict?”
“Um… it looks fine at first glance, but… it’s saying the color changes partway through.”
The assistant answers Father.
“So, that means it’s black?”
“Then, it’s destroy time.”
When I grabbed the spear, Ren and Itsuki tried to stop me.
What are you doing?
“Alright, here we go.”
The physician flipped the switch on some device with a snap. The Soul Vacuum seemed to twitch slightly with a faint crackling sound.
Oh? It’s starting to move actively now. Then, it emitted something again.
“It says it can see the seams and the places where things were forcibly coated, nano! Amazing, nano!”
This time, Rival stepped in as the interpreter.
“Has the accuracy improved… maybe?”
“It was still in the research stage. There’s a function that can temporarily enhance a monster’s abilities. But I wouldn’t recommend using it for too long.”
“So, what do we do? It’s saying it’s black, right?”
“I don’t think it’s entirely black… but…”
“We can deal with the next stage too. What should we do?”
“For now, let’s report to Rollick.”
Father stepped out from the bushes and called for Rollick and his group. The target pig seemed eager to follow, but one of the knights held it back.
“I just used a certain method to evaluate the soul, and… it looks really suspicious.”
“W-What…?”
The knight turned back toward the pig with a shocked expression.
“Oink!”
The pig tilted its head and let out a squeal. Then, the pig waved its hoof at me for some reason. Soon after, the pig that seemed to be Rollick’s companion came walking toward me.
“It’s whispering something like ‘the hidden character is here,’ but what is it talking about?”
“Hidden character… could it be Motoyasu-kun?”
Ren let out a sigh.
“What a crappy game.”
“Agreed. That character is completely impossible to beat for someone like him.”
“I’d rather just hand him over.”
“Seriously though, how are we supposed to beat him…?”
Impossible to beat? There’s no way a pig could ever ‘conquer’ me. I’ve already been conquered by Filo-tan. I would never, ever cheat.
“No matter what, there’s no route that leads anywhere. It’s a dead end with that woman.”
“According to Motoyasu-kun, maybe she came here before awakening to love? If that’s the case, there’s a slight possibility.”
“Or rather, that woman… she’s even glancing at us a little…”
“Oh, it looks like she noticed Ren. And Itsuki too… She’s trying to hide the aura, but… homo…”
Father is striking a strange pose. I don’t want to say it, but it’s a bit creepy. Even Father seems to realize it.
“Naofumi-san, what’s with that pronunciation…?”
“They say geeks recognize their own. That’s definitely black. Even if they try to hide it, you can tell. Just from the slight reaction, it’s obvious.”
Does she think no one’s watching her? Even when everyone looks away, her hands or her eyes give off slight hints at times. That’s why she gets found out.
“R-Really? I don’t get it at all… is she really doing something like that?”
“Yeah… I didn’t notice until it was pointed out.”
“Same here. Is she making some strange movements? I can’t sense anything beyond the words she’s using.”
“Well… it’s not even worth looking. She probably only sees me as a background character.”
“Hmm… so, does that mean Naofumi is outside her field of recognition?”
“Father’s face isn’t bad, I say.”
When comparing the four heroes, he may not stand out much, but if asked whether he’s good-looking or not, I’d say he’s on the better side.
Maybe he doesn’t leave an impression because of his gentle eyes and slightly relaxed expression? The Father from the first world had a sharp intensity that even made my heart flutter.

“Motoyasu-kun, stop looking at me with those maiden-like eyes. So, Rollick-san. Our collaborator Rato-san said she can handle the next step. What do you want to do? We’re not demons. If we can prevent wrongdoing, we’re willing to put in the effort.”
“Please! Save the real princess!”
“She might already be dead, but are you okay with that?”
“Yes. I can’t stand the thought of someone manipulating her body and pretending to be her!”
“Understood. Then, heroes, order the Soul Vacuum to extract the soul. Aim properly.”
“Eh? O-Okay.”
Father pointed at the pig and ordered it to suck out the soul. The Soul Vacuum responded and began inhaling deeply.
“Bubuu!?”
The wind started to blow around us. Then, the pig stumbled and leaned against the wall.
Was the wind that strong?
“Bubu… Bubububu!”
The pig seemed to be seeking help from the knight standing beside it.
“Eh? Eh?”
The knight, being appealed to, looked back and forth between us and the pig.
“Bubububu! Bububu!”
It seemed to be muttering something to try and stop it, but I couldn’t understand it.
Was it begging for its life in pig language?
“Oh, I need to test this research item too.”
The physician took out several bluish-white magnifying glasses and handed them to us.
“Use this to look at the target.”
Following the instructions, we used the magnifying glasses to look at the pig. We saw something… a pig’s head was growing and trying to escape from the pig’s body.
What is this?
Chapter 700 – Item
“Buhii!”
The pig fiercely resisted, firing magic at us in defiance.
“Air Strike Shield! Air One-Way Shield!”
Father deflected it using his skills. Even as a counterattack, it was weak.
Was it not meant for combat? As I was thinking that, a spell resembling something of Dryfa-class came flying toward us.
The knight looked shocked.
“Her Highness shouldn’t have been able to use such powerful magic…”
“If she challenged the Seven Star Weapon, she might be able to pull it out. Though by improper means.”
“Bububububuhi!!”
Now showing murderous intent, it charged straight at us. And it looked like it was trying to take the knight beside it as a hostage.
“What are you doing to the princess!?”
A knight with a strange look in his eyes appeared and tried to attack us. This feels just like the time with the ghost crimson swine.
“I’ll return those words right back at you! What do you think you’re doing to the heroes!?”
Rollick drew his sword and countered. As expected of a guard knight, he’s quite skilled.
“Bubububububu! Bubububu, bubububu!”
The pig was saying something to Rollick, as if interrogating him. Rollick snapped back at the words.
“The one I love is the princess, not the invader who has taken over her body! Get out now, evil spirit!”
As Rollick spat those words, the pig roared furiously in response.
“What is it saying?”
“It’s the same as always—‘The person I know wouldn’t say such things! I’ll definitely make things right! I’ll live my life the way I want!’—yeah, she’s making a fuss again.”
“For now—”
Ren and Itsuki quickly fired bullets into the foreheads of both the pig and the deranged knight who seemed ready to become its follower.
A headshot!
“Well done!”
I gave a thumbs-up, but Itsuki looked at me with exasperation.
“No, we didn’t. It was a paralysis bullet…”
“Seriously, why is Motoyasu always like this…”
Ren sighed in frustration.
I don’t know what he’s talking about. What’s the point of holding back here? The pig’s follower went down easily, but the pig itself stood firm, unfazed. It’s still full of energy.
“The disguise has completely fallen apart. This might be a way to distinguish those who are controlling a body.”
“First, I’d like you to help me with my experiment, okay?”
Come to think of it, what exactly does the doctor’s tool do? It looks like it can see souls.
“Bububububu!”
“Output boost.”

The doctor poured magic into the collar-like component of the Soul Vacuum. The suction power of the Soul Vacuum increased. Bit by bit, the target’s soul was being forced out of the body. At this stage, the soul seemed to be properly attached to the body.
“Bububububu!”
But what is this? The pig’s body and the pig’s soul looked different. If I had to compare, the body was like an Iberian pig, while the soul was more like a Yorkshire pig. And the soul looked older.
Souls don’t seem to correspond with age, do they?
“Bububububu!”
“Come on! Return that body to the princess! Even if the princess is no longer of this world, her body belongs to her!”
“Bububububububuhiiii!!”
Even though it was enraged by Rollick’s words, it couldn’t resist, and its soul was slowly being pulled out. However, this might still take time, and it felt like it might slip back in.
“Impossible? If it’s impossible, give up right away.”
It seemed like the Soul Vacuum was saying something to the doctor, my rival, and the assistant.
“I see… I can do it alone, but I might go too far…”
“That’s a difficult request.”
“It would’ve been nice if the heroes had Soul Vacuum-type weapons.”
“What’s wrong?”
Father asked.
“Well, since we can see it through the lense, it’s okay to attack the exposed parts to weaken it. That’s what it said, but—”
“Understood!”
I stabbed the pig’s head with my Soul Eater Spear.
“Buhyaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!!”
The pig’s death cry was loud and chaotic. While I was at it, I yanked the soul right out. I dragged it out with a squelching sound.
“Whoa… It came out cleanly!?”
“Isn’t that bad? What about the original body’s owner!?”
“Exactly! Motoyasu, please return it quickly.”
“Whether it’s weakening it or returning it, this is such a hassle.”
“No, this is perfect. Just hold it down as it struggles and lift it toward the Soul Vacuum.”
Oh? Is this a stroke of luck?
“I was holding back because it’s hard to control the output, but if it’s this sturdy, I have no choice but to go all out.”
The doctor seemed to have raised the output of the equipment considerably. With a crackling sound, the suction power of the Soul Vacuum increased.
“Bububu… bububu… bubuu!”

Even after being pierced by me, the pig’s soul was being peeled away. On the other hand, the connection to the body was gradually being restored. Upon closer inspection, I could see that the coated part was peeling off. I see, this is where it was wrapped around. The Soul Vacuum moved in without hesitation and unwrapped the entanglement as it sucked it in. Eventually, the soul completely separated into two. One was a pig, the same size as the body. And the other… what is this? A hideous pig.
“A plump Japanese woman…?”
“Feels like an old lady.”
“Yeah, she doesn’t seem to have a very pleasant personality.”
Father and the others murmured.
“Bububu! Bubu!”
“Who are you going to sue!? We just exorcised an evil spirit that had possessed a girl…”
Another pointless argument?
“Well, it’s probably an envoy of the enemy, so it’s best to get rid of it.”
“Agreed. Soul Vacuum, do it.”

Following Itsuki’s command, the Soul Vacuum took a deep breath. The ghost pig fell from my spear and was sucked into the Soul Vacuum. It struggled hard, but in its soul form, it was powerless against the Soul Vacuum. It was devoured. With this, the enemy that possessed others and took over their bodies was defeated.
“My research has made significant progress.”
The doctor removed the equipment attached to the Soul Vacuum.
“Is it safe to remove it now?”
“There’s no problem. The Soul Vacuum only eats undead. It’s the fault of the dead pretending to be alive.”
“You managed to separate them well.”
“As long as the connection unravels, it works. The research will move forward by tweaking the output and other settings.”
“That was an incredible battle…”
“Princess!”
Rollick lifted the fallen pig in his arms.
“B… bu…”
The pig weakly opened its eyes and spoke to Rollick.
“Bubu… bubububu…”
As it spoke, it placed its hoof on Rollick’s cheek.
“Bububububu, bubububuhi.”
“Y-Yes! I’m happy too! This time, let’s go for a nice walk together.”
Rollick and the pig seemed to be making a promise. Well, I have no objections to other people’s hobbies.
“Heroes, thank you so much! I will definitely repay this favor…!”
After bowing deeply to us, Rollick hurriedly carried the pig away. Perhaps he was headed to the clinic.
“What was it saying?”
“It seems that the princess was aware and retained her memories even when her body was possessed. So, she was thanking Rollick and us.”
“She was very sincere in her gratitude. It was completely different from the fake attitude she had while being possessed.”
“Ah, that’s it. I felt the same difference as between that princess and her younger sister, even from just a few words.”
“Yeah, like the difference between the ghost and Melty. The sense of refinement is immediately apparent.”

And so, it seems we achieved the outcome we were tasked with. The pig aside, being thanked by someone feels good. Even Father and the others looked refreshed for the first time in a while. There had been nothing but troublesome incidents recently, after all.
